name: en_to_fr_noun
description: Translate a short English sentence into French; answer is the French final noun. Control: same sentence pair reversed (French->English), answer is the English noun.
generator_code:
import random, json
random.seed(0)
nouns=[("house","maison","la"),("table","table","la"),("car","voiture","la"),("door","porte","la"),("window","fenêtre","la"),("book","livre","le"),("garden","jardin","le"),("kitchen","cuisine","la"),("city","ville","la"),("street","rue","la"),("school","école","l'"),("church","église","l'"),("forest","forêt","la"),("river","rivière","la"),("bed","lit","le"),("box","boîte","la"),("bag","sac","le"),("tree","arbre","l'"),("room","chambre","la"),("market","marché","le"),("train","train","le"),("boat","bateau","le"),("park","parc","le"),("office","bureau","le"),("village","village","le"),("bottle","bouteille","la"),("shop","magasin","le"),("field","champ","le"),("castle","château","le"),("library","bibliothèque","la")]
subj=[("The dog","Le chien"),("The cat","Le chat"),("My brother","Mon frère"),("The child","L'enfant"),("The teacher","Le professeur"),("My mother","Ma mère")]
preps=[("is in","est dans"),("is near","est près de"),("is behind","est derrière"),("is under","est sous"),("sleeps in","dort dans"),("waits behind","attend derrière")]
items=[];ctrl=[];seen=set()
while len(items)<120:
    n=random.choice(nouns);s=random.choice(subj);p=random.choice(preps)
    key=(n[0],s[0],p[0])
    if key in seen: continue
    seen.add(key)
    art=n[2]; frart=art if art=="l'" else art+" "
    en=f"{s[0]} {p[0]} the {n[0]}."
    fr_prefix=f"{s[1]} {p[1]} {frart}".rstrip()
    sep="" if art=="l'" else " "
    if art=="l'":
        items.append({"prompt":f"English: {en}\nFrench: {s[1]} {p[1]} l'","answer":n[1]})
    else:
        items.append({"prompt":f"English: {en}\nFrench: {s[1]} {p[1]} {art}","answer":" "+n[1]})
    frfull=f"{s[1]} {p[1]} {frart}{n[1]}."
    ctrl.append({"prompt":f"French: {frfull}\nEnglish: {s[0]} {p[0]} the","answer":" "+n[0]})
json.dump({"items":items,"control":ctrl},open('/work/skill.json','w'),ensure_ascii=False)
